metaTitle: How to Break In Hiking Boots
description: A four-week break-in schedule for hiking boots, with sock, lacing and hot spot fixes, plus when to stop and return boots that do not fit.
directAnswer: Break in boots gradually: wear them at home, then on walks that grow longer and heavier over two to four weeks, with your hiking socks. Treat hot spots at once, and return boots that cause pain or repeated blisters.
